title: BNCI 2015-008 Center Speller P300 dataset
description: EEG recordings from 13 participants performing a gaze-independent P300 speller task, the Center Speller variant. The task relies on covert spatial attention and non-spatial feature attention (color and form). Six geometric shapes were presented sequentially at the screen center while participants silently counted target intensifications. The data are provided as a BIDS derivative with target and non-target event annotations, and are intended for evaluating ERP-based brain-computer interface classification.
methods_description: EEG was recorded from 63 active Brain Products actiCAP electrodes in a 10-10 layout, referenced to the left mastoid, at a sampling rate of 250 Hz after downsampling. Participants fixated the screen center and covertly attended to the target symbol, with a stimulus onset asynchrony of 200 ms and 10 sequences of 6 elements per stage. Offline preprocessing included a Chebyshev low-pass filter below 49 Hz, re-referencing to linked mastoids, and baseline correction over the 200 ms prestimulus interval. Classification used LDA with shrinkage covariance.
